name: Stub Client Agent
description: Stands in for the client-agent in the frontend's end-to-end tests. Answers each chat turn with a fixed reply, and with a sample mesh, IFC model or diagram when the prompt asks for one. Never calls an LLM.

skills.name: Answer Chat
skills.description: Return a fixed answer to a chat prompt, with a sample artifact when the prompt names a mesh, an IFC model or a diagram.
skills.usage_notes: End-to-end tests only. Deterministic apart from artifact ids.
